meta.method:
Built by a script from de/golden.yaml, not extracted by a model. Every quote is
a real span of the parsed page its label cites -- spans deliberately widened (8) and
narrowed (14) so the matcher's tolerance is exercised -- and every 13th mandatory
bid-eligibility label was dropped (8 of 105) so recall is not trivially 1.00.
Added on top: 1 post-award label, so the stage filter is scored in both directions
(ADR-0015); 2 sentence(s) from documents the answer key excludes, which no label can
explain; and 2 judgement field(s) changed, so the disagreement lists are not empty.
It exists so `scripts/recall.py` can be run end to end offline. The recall it yields is a
property of this file. It measures nothing about the extractor.
